issue: Category and Sub Category levels come from dimproductcategory and dimproductsubcategory, but the Product dimension has no relationships
impact: Slicing by Category or Sub Category may fail or return wrong totals
recommendation: Add dimension relationships: dimproduct.productsubcategorykey -> Sub Category, dimproductsubcategory.productcategorykey -> Category

issue: years, Quarters and the secondary monthname repeat their level's key column
impact: BI users see each date attribute twice
recommendation: Remove the duplicates, or point them at quarter_name / month_name

issue: The month level and monthname secondary are labelled monthname but show month_id
impact: Users expect month names and get numeric ids
recommendation: Use month_name as the name column, or relabel it Month ID

impact: A sum of unit prices across orders is rarely meaningful
recommendation: Use average, or keep sum and label it clearly

issue: Product_Category dimension is not used by any model
impact: Repo clutter; overlaps Product's Category level
recommendation: Remove it, or add it to the model if needed
